checks.description: Frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains keys name and description only; name equals 'subject-lines'.

checks.description: Each set offers several real subject options, not one.
checks.rule: Each subject set lists three to five distinct options that are real alternatives, not padding.

checks.description: Exactly one option per set is flagged as the chosen primary.
checks.rule: Across options[] in a set, exactly one has primary true; the rest are primary false.

checks.description: Subjects hold the length and clarity bar for the inbox preview.
checks.rule: Each subject is short and clear at a glance, roughly 40 characters or fewer where the angle allows, no clickbait.

checks.description: Subjects fit the mobile inbox, key word in the first 30 characters.
checks.rule: Each subject aims for roughly 30 to 40 characters with the key word inside the first 30; most opens are mobile where iPhone shows roughly 33 to 35 characters.

checks.description: The angle lands in the first few words, before truncation.
checks.rule: Each subject front-loads its message; the angle is readable in the first few words, not after a slow wind-up.

checks.description: A deliberate preheader is set for the set, true to the body.
checks.rule: The set carries a preheader, roughly 40 to 90 characters, set on purpose and true to the paired email body, not spilled body text.

checks.description: Each subject is true to the paired email body, no overpromise.
checks.rule: Each set carries an email_ref and its subjects match the promise the paired email body keeps.

checks.description: No em dash character anywhere in the file or example copy.
checks.rule: The file contains zero U+2014 em dash characters.
No Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669); digits are 0-9 only.

checks.description: No tatweel or kashida in Arabic copy.
checks.rule: The file contains zero U+0640 tatweel characters.

checks.description: No invented offer, price, Skill Path title, or instructor name; empowering not deficit-framed.
checks.rule: Subjects reference only offers and prices traceable to the brief, speak to what the reader can build, and never shame.
